$comment: feat.containerport (FEAT-099, §33/§28/§47; resources-design-brief.md §8-§9) — the Felixstowe-class deep-sea container-terminal tier data contract. Every tunable figure the container-port feature consumes — the port-tier ladder (milestone + cost), and each tier's berths, crane rate, operating hours, customs throughput, ship tonnage and jobs — lives here, never as a Go literal in internal/engine/freight/containerport*.go (GR#15).

units.milestone: milestone tier (M-number; the §4 milestone ladder the tier unlocks at)
units.costMillions: millions of pounds (£M) — placeholder build cost for ladder ordering
units.customsCapacityTonnesPerDay: customs throughput capacity, SEPARATE from physical berth/crane throughput (tonnes/day)
units.shipTonnage: largest ship the tier can berth (tonnes/ship)

meta.ladderNote: This file is the PORT-TIER LADDER — cargo_port_small -> container_terminal -> deep_sea_terminal — the same ladder data/buildings.json's PT catalogue names (cargo_port_small M7+£ 40M, container_terminal M9+DP 150M). cargo_port_small and container_terminal mirror those catalogue entries and data/freight.json's active port (berths 2 / crane 60 t/hr / 16 hours / customs 1500 t/day IS the container_terminal tier) so the deep-sea tier can be asserted as a genuine rung ABOVE them (AC-2/AC-3). The deep-sea tier is the new capacity step ('10x bulk' / deep-sea), not a renamed container_terminal.
meta.balanceNote: EVERY numeric figure below — milestone, cost, berths, crane rate, hours, customs throughput, ship tonnage, jobs — is a COARSE DIRECTIONAL PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (standing balance-number regime). No junior-invented final figure satisfies any AC; tests check direction/structure only (the deep-sea tier out-thrusts container_terminal; more berths => more capacity; saturating customs raises smuggling risk), never a pinned magnitude.

tiers.name: Cargo port (small)
tiers.disclosure: PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass: milestone (7), costMillions (40 £M), berths (1), craneRateTonnesPerHour (30 t/hr), operatingHoursPerDay (12 h/day), customsCapacityTonnesPerDay (400 t/day), shipTonnage (3000 t/ship), jobs (200) — mirrors data/buildings.json cargo_port_small and data/freight.json's lower-tier port.

tiers.name: Container terminal
tiers.disclosure: PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass: milestone (9), costMillions (150 £M), berths (2), craneRateTonnesPerHour (60 t/hr), operatingHoursPerDay (16 h/day), customsCapacityTonnesPerDay (1500 t/day), shipTonnage (3000 t/ship), jobs (600) — mirrors data/buildings.json container_terminal (M9+DP 150M '10x bulk') and data/freight.json's active port.

tiers.name: Deep-sea container terminal
tiers.disclosure: PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass: milestone (9), costMillions (400 £M), berths (6), craneRateTonnesPerHour (240 t/hr), operatingHoursPerDay (24 h/day), customsCapacityTonnesPerDay (12000 t/day), shipTonnage (40000 t/ship = the 40 kt deep-sea container ship), jobs (2000) — the Felixstowe-class rung above container_terminal; figures are directional and distinct-from-and-larger-than container_terminal (AC-3), not a pinned magnitude.
